content: Prompt v3 (src/agent/prompts/v3.ts). Case: A viewing request without any property: the agent asks what they're looking for instead of booking
Can I book a viewing for tomorrow at 3pm?

Current time in Dubai: Mon 16 Nov 2026, 14:05 (UTC+4).
Lead status: new.
Saved so far: nothing yet.
Still unknown: purpose, areas, beds, budgetAed, timeline, financing.

Yes, 3pm tomorrow is free: Tue 17 Nov 2026, 15:00. Which property would you like to view? If you send me the listing or the area you have in mind, I'll confirm the booking. I can also offer 14:00 or 16:00 if 3pm doesn't work.
